tasks.title: Part 2
tasks.instruction: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
tasks.prompt: In many countries, more people are choosing to live alone or in very small households. What are the reasons for this trend? Do you think it is a positive or negative development?
tasks.guidance: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
